stories.title: Russian drone strikes train after Johnson leaves Ukraine station
new_facts: Experts suggest the dignitary-carrying trains were the intended targets of the drone strike, not incidental.
Poland joins Ukraine in formally accusing Russia of 'escalation' over the border train strikes.
Ex-CIA director David Petraeus was also near the targeted train station, per Ukraine's rail operator.
Overnight barrage of 450+ drones/missiles killed at least six and injured 40+ across Ukraine; foreign minister calls strike 'Putin's terror knocking on EU/Nato doors'.
Ukrainian drone evades Russian helicopter fire to strike an oil tanker, per released footage.
Names ex-Swedish PM Carl Bildt among foreign officials whose train had passed on the struck line minutes earlier.
Boris Johnson gives on-record quote condemning Putin over the train strike.
stories.line: Russian drone struck a Ukrainian passenger train minutes after Boris Johnson and other Western officials departed, raising questions about targeting.

stories.title: Pennsylvania woman dies from measles, third state death this year
new_facts: 40-year-old unvaccinated woman from Jefferson County, PA, died of measles complications, coroner says.
Death marks PA's third measles death this year; US having worst resurgence in 35 years.
Woman died Saturday; two prior PA deaths were infants, one with a genetic defect.
stories.line: A Pennsylvania woman died from measles complications, the state's third measles death this year as cases continue spreading.

stories.title: Obama urges Democrats to prioritize AI regulation

Obama specifically urged Hakeem Jeffries to launch a public conversation on AI policy.
stories.line: Obama tells Democrats that AI regulation should be a priority, calling the technology potentially dangerous without oversight.

Amodei's open letter urging to 'pace the frontier'; Hassabis's tentative support; Trump and Johnson dismiss concerns.

New story: Speaker Johnson leads GOP skepticism on Trump's $5,000 'bribe,' which lacks both GOP and Dem support.
